test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Among six girls, Natasha, Yuvika, Aditi, Tanya, Shahnaz and Daljeet, each one has a different shortest among all. Aditi is taller than only Natasha and one another girl. Shahnaz is shorter than Daljeet, who is shorter than Yuvika. Who is the third tallest among all six girls?
solution:
Given: Six girls Natasha, Yuvika, Aditi, Tanya, Shahnaz, and Daljeet are comparing their heights.

No two girls are of the same height.

1) Aditi is taller than only Natasha and one other girl.

__ > __ > __ > Aditi > __ > Natasha

2) Shahnaz is shorter than Daljeet, who is shorter than Yuvika.

Yuvika > Daljeet > Shahnaz

Combining the information:

From the first statement, since Aditi is taller than Natasha and one other girl, Aditi must be the fourth tallest.

From the second statement, the order among Yuvika, Daljeet, and Shahnaz is clear.

Thus, the height order is:

Yuvika > Daljeet > Shahnaz > Aditi > __ > Natasha

Since Aditi is the fourth tallest and there are only one girl left, Tanya must be the one taller than Natasha but shorter than Aditi.

So the final order is:

Yuvika > Daljeet > Shahnaz > Aditi > Tanya > Natasha

Therefore, the third tallest girl is Shahnaz.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
